    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs=""
>
[Pain is Temporary](/Feats.aspx?ID=5263) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="All Ancestries" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=467" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=561" />
<trait label="Reincarnated" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=783" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 80

**Frequency**
once per 10 minutes

</column>

---

Sangpotshi practitioners know that suffering is a fleeting sensation that ultimately strengthens the soul and prepares it for a new reincarnation. Bolstered by this understanding, you've learned to temporarily steel yourself against all forms of pain. You gain resistance 10 to all damage until the end of your next turn.
